decisions.reason: Premium customer support is tightly linked to the firm's core managed hosting business, uses existing service capabilities, and is cheap to keep open while continuing to learn about customer willingness to pay.
The software version management tool fits the firm's platform-and-tools strategy for agencies and developers, so despite ongoing development costs it still looks like a worthwhile option to retain.

The data processing contract generator appears more peripheral and time-specific than the firm's core hosting and support offer, so by 2022 its upside is likely clearer and not strong enough to justify continued attention.
Scalable hosting for agencies was presented as a flagship offer, matches the firm's strategic direction and core assets, and in a growing market there is little reason to abandon it now.
